goal: Keep the current world label fully readable in the mobile global header without breaking routes that also include the search shortcut.

intent_model.literal_request: Repair and lock the upper header because the page type is not visible, while accounting for pages with a search icon.
intent_model.implied_outcome: One robust shared mobile header composition for every public route variant.
likely_rejections: Only the events route is fixed.
The search icon variant still crowds the label.
The logo or another utility control is hidden or cropped.
The label fits only by becoming unreadably small or losing the chooser indicator.

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Add an explicit shared layout contract and regression tests across affected route variants and breakpoints.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: A screenshot-only CSS tweak is insufficient.

cognitive_flow.current_layer: The visitor must immediately recognize the current world and all available header actions.
cognitive_flow.current_decision: Open the current-world chooser or use another visible header action.
deferred_complexity: World destinations inside the opened chooser
preserved_depth: Global search on routes without an in-page search surface
Language selection through the menu at the narrowest search-header widths

natural_destination: VII global header on mobile world pages and place-detail pages

facts.claim: The compact events label currently wraps because narrow media rules force the trigger down to 56 or 44 pixels and allow wrapping anywhere.
facts.evidence: app/globals.css compact world selector rules and supplied screenshots

facts.claim: Some routes render an additional header search action when no in-page search surface exists.

assumptions.claim: Language access may move into the existing main menu only on extremely narrow routes that also need the header search action.
assumptions.validation: Verify the main menu retains language choices and the header no longer overflows.

in_scope: Shared compact world selector sizing and wrapping rules
Space-priority behavior when the header search icon is present
Regression tests and rendered checks at 390, 360 and 340 pixels
out_of_scope: Changes to world labels or destinations
invariants: Visible action touch targets remain at least 44 pixels high.
World chooser chevron remains visible and the chooser still opens.
Header search remains available on routes that require it.
Modern Hebrew font stack remains unchanged.

requirements.statement: The compact current-world label is fully visible on one line at every supported narrow width.
The header-search route variant fits without horizontal overflow or missing required controls.
The world chooser remains identifiable and interactive after the layout repair.

acceptance_checks.setup: Open the events page at 390, 360 and 340 pixels.
acceptance_checks.action: Inspect and measure the compact current-world trigger.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The complete label appears on one line inside the trigger with no clipping or overflow.

acceptance_checks.setup: Open a business page at the same widths where the header search icon is rendered.
acceptance_checks.action: Inspect all visible header actions and page horizontal geometry.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Search, current-world selector and menu remain visible, the logo is intact and document width does not exceed viewport width.

acceptance_checks.setup: Open and close the current-world chooser and change the viewport width.
acceptance_checks.action: Repeat the interaction after the transition.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The trigger retains its label and chevron, and the chooser continues to open and close correctly.

acceptance_checks.setup: Render the most crowded header variant at 340 pixels.
acceptance_checks.action: Measure the selector label, header controls and document width.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The layout fails the gate if the label wraps or clips, any required control is outside the viewport, or horizontal overflow is present.

acceptance_checks.setup: Reload both route variants at a narrow width.
acceptance_checks.action: Wait for hydration and inspect the header again.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: No transient or final state reintroduces the clipped two-line label.

authorization_boundary: Local implementation and verification only. A production publication requires separate explicit authorization.
